summary: Porch Group discloses via Form 8-K that its captive reinsurance subsidiary, Porticus Reinsurance Ltd., purchased 2,092,050 shares of Porch common stock from Porch Reciprocal Exchange at $7.17 per share ($15M aggregate). This intra-group sale converts reciprocal's non-admitted equity into cash to boost statutory surplus, not an arm's-length acquisition. No tender, premium, or external change of control. Filing is a material agreement disclosure (Item 1.01) with routine mechanics: treasury shares, no voting rights, unregistered sale exempt under Section 4(a)(1). No special-situation event—an internal capital optimization, not a market-facing deal. What to watch: registration intent for Porticus shares, but no risk-arb angle.
